items.verbatim_snippet:
Hospital: Hamilton Health Sciences Corporation
Issue: PHIPA Access Request and Reasonable Search Complaint
Paragraph blurb: The parents of a pediatric patient filed a formal complaint with the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario (IPC) under the Personal Health Information Protection Act, 2004 (PHIPA) after requesting their child's medical records from Hamilton Health Sciences. Although the hospital granted access to initial records, the complainants maintained that additional responsive documents existed. The IPC adjudicator determined that the hospital's search was insufficient and ordered Hamilton Health Sciences to conduct a comprehensive secondary search and issue a revised access decision within 30 days.
Date: May 13, 2026
Source: Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario (IPC) — PHIPA Decision 338 (Complaint HA25-00348)
